eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 2:25 PM on AUG 30, 2021 Effective until 12:25 AM AUG 31, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Maricopa County. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety.  Phoenix Police Department is looking for Aloys,  Ntirush wamaboko,  an one hundred and three year old, black, male, with grey hair, brown eyes, five feet, one inch tall, weighing one hundred pounds.  It is unknown what he was wearing.  He was last seen on foot in the area of north, 43rd Avenue,  and west, Thomas road.  He only speaks Swahili.  He suffers from dementia. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
